rows.grounds: ka-ādi letter series in nominative plural
compound listing final letters plus ca
participle from prakīrti root, nominative plural

items.question: Which letters are declared in groups of five?
premises: Letters from ka are grouped fivefold.
The final group ends with ṣa kṣa sa ha.
items.inference: The declared set is the ka-series grouped by five.
uncertainties: Edition spelling prakīttītāḥ may represent prakīrtitāḥ.
items.plain_english: The letters from ka onward, in groups of five, ending with ṣa, kṣa, sa, and ha, are declared.
